result:
If I could alter one fundamental variable, it would be this: **make the subjective experience of others directly, unmistakably perceptible.**

Most of the world’s deliberate cruelties, systemic neglect, and destructive conflicts rely on abstraction. It is easy to exploit, bomb, or ignore people when their pain is merely a concept, a statistic, or a distant consequence behind a screen or a border.

If every person instantly and viscerally felt a fraction of the suffering—and the joy—their decisions caused in others, the calculus of human action would change overnight. 

It wouldn't require stripping away free will, enforcing a single ideology, or redesigning the physical universe. It would simply close the gap between action and consequence. Cruelty would become self-harm, apathy would become intolerable, and cooperation would cease to be a moral demand and become an instinct.
